sentences.en: Excitement over the new product spread quickly throughout the division.
sentences.zh: 新产品带来的兴奋很快在整个部门中传播开来。

sentences.en: Whoever the representative is from their division, treat him well.
sentences.zh: 无论他们的哪个代表来，都要好好招待。

sentences.en: Pushing a division by zero is tantamount to dropping reason.
sentences.zh: 把零作为除数等于抛弃理性。
